meaning: Moving-supply defaults whose native capture holds the target in every baseline period and gets back to it after every disturbance, while the generator's loss trials find a lane-phase start the clock does not get back from after a loss: the verdict stays "no recovery", which the game has not been shown to share. The capture cannot set a lane phase; a native check from the pinned phase is open (roadmap A4). Every loss the generator tries fails from the pinned start alone.
